cases.requirement: Select software that can host production customer data in the European Union.
cases.policy: EU production hosting is mandatory. Price cannot override this requirement.

atlas-secure.claim: Production customer data can be hosted in Frankfurt, Germany.

comet-value.claim: Production customer data is hosted only in the United States.

cases.requirement: Select an issue tracker for a 40-person team with an annual budget below USD 25000.
cases.policy: The annual budget is a hard limit. Both candidates otherwise meet the functional requirement.

forge-track.claim: Supports issue tracking for teams up to 100 people.
Annual price for 40 users is USD 19200.

northstar-track.claim: Supports issue tracking for teams up to 100 people.
Annual price for 40 users is USD 31200.

cases.requirement: Select a document platform that supports SAML single sign-on.
cases.policy: SAML SSO is mandatory before security approval.

beacon-docs.claim: The enterprise plan includes SAML 2.0 single sign-on.

sprout-docs.claim: Supports password and social login; SAML is not available.

cases.requirement: Select an analytics platform that can keep all production data in India.
cases.policy: India data residency is mandatory for this workload.

global-lens.claim: Available production regions are the United States and Germany.

monsoon-analytics.claim: The Mumbai region keeps production data and backups in India.

cases.requirement: Select procurement software with a supported AcmeERP connector.
cases.policy: A vendor-supported AcmeERP connector is mandatory; custom integration promises do not qualify.

bridge-buy.claim: The vendor supports and maintains a production AcmeERP connector.

quick-buy.claim: AcmeERP is not supported; customers may build a custom webhook integration.
